title: bot.ability.persona.recalled
description: Private bring-up result: the description this bot woke up with, if any.

anyOf.description: A description the bot wrote of itself (JSON in memory, query_tags=self_persona). A bot starts with none; this row exists only because the bot revised its description.

text.description: The whole description, in the bot's own words, exactly as it wrote it.
text.title: Text

reason.description: Why the bot revised its description, in its own words.
reason.title: Reason

traits.description: The owner-given traits the bot had when it wrote this description.
traits.title: Traits

kind.description: Always `fact`: a description is a fact about the bot, never an instruction.
kind.title: Kind

anyOf.title: Description
